title: Real artifact content contract gate
summary: Moved the daily content contract from self-test-only validation to a real-artifact gate. `npm run content:contract` now scans recent `reports-data` reports and matching public HTML when available; `npm run validate` runs that real gate before the synthetic self-test fixture.

validation_commands: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8')); if(!pkg.scripts.validate.includes('npm run content:contract && npm run content:contract:self-test')){ console.error('validate does not run real content:contract before self-test'); process.exit(1) }"

degraded_sections.message: `npm run content:contract` checked the latest three real report artifacts and surfaced story template narrative degradation for 2026-06-23 and 2026-06-24.

lessons.lesson: Content validation must exercise real reports before downstream generation rewrites.
lessons.evidence: `npm run content:contract` now scans recent real artifacts and reports blocking/degraded counts instead of requiring an explicit `--report` path.
lessons.recommended_action: Use the real-artifact gate as the red/green signal before admission/scoring and authoring changes.

lessons.lesson: Current real artifacts still contain degraded template narrative even when there are no blocking contract issues.
lessons.evidence: The new gate reports degraded story template narrative for 2026-06-23 and 2026-06-24 while exiting successfully because there are no blocking issues.
lessons.recommended_action: Next slice should decide whether REQ-003 story template narrative remains degraded or becomes blocking after authoring/admission improvements land.

suggestions.issue: Validation could previously pass by checking only synthetic content-contract fixtures.
suggestions.evidence: The red test failed because `npm run validate` only ran `content:contract:self-test`; after the change it runs `content:contract` before `content:contract:self-test`.
suggestions.suggestion: Keep real-artifact content-contract validation in `npm run validate` and use self-test only as a secondary smoke check.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Future generation, admission, and authoring changes can no longer avoid the latest real reports during standard validation.
suggestions.promotion_path: Implemented through package scripts, content-contract CLI, tests, ledger, quick reference, and requirements reconciliation.

followups.action: Implement the admission/scoring rewrite next, using the real-artifact content-contract output as the regression signal.
After authoring improves real reports, consider making `story_template_narrative` blocking instead of degraded.
